pr_title: posix: add stubs for signal.h functions that need process support
pr_body:
Since Zephyr itself does not currently support processes, but conformant applications should still be able to link, add stubs for the remaining POSIX functions in the `POSIX_SIGNALS` Option Group.

The `POSIX_SIGNALS` Option Group is required for PSE51, PSE52, PSE53, PSE54, and likely many other POSIX Subprofiles.

> [!NOTE]  
> There is a Coding Guidelines false positive about declaring the `raise()` function (from C89).

[Doc Preview](https://builds.zephyrproject.io/zephyr/pr/74436/docs/services/portability/posix/index.html)

Fixes #59925
Fixes #59933
Fixes #66923
Fixes #66924
Fixes #66925
Fixes #66929
Fixes #66930

issue_context.title: posix: implement `sigwait()`
issue_context.body:
This is part of the See [POSIX Roadmap for LTSv3](https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/51211) (RFC #51211).

`sigwait()` is required as part of `POSIX_SIGNALS` [Subprofiling Option Group](https://pubs.opengroup.org/onlinepubs/9699919799/xrat/V4_subprofiles.html).

For more information, please refer to https://pubs.opengroup.org/onlinepubs/9699919799/functions/sigwait.html
